text: 据华尔街日报：美国参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦正敦促特美国商务部解释计划中的通胀数据调整。计划中的调整预计将导致通胀读数降低，这可能影响利率。沃伦表示，商务部有义务向公众解释相关调整背后的理由和流程。
text_en: According to the Wall Street Journal, U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren is urging the U.S. Commerce Department to explain its planned inflation data adjustment. The adjustment is expected to lower inflation readings, which could affect interest rates. Warren stated that the Commerce Department has an obligation to explain to the public the rationale and process behind the adjustment.
